harness_quality.oracle: The driver reads the rendered Data tab/card, checks exact success JSON, no-match explanation/absence of rows, failure detail, and enabled Extract action. It also checks fixture content at each controlled route and records the pattern reads as signed-in HTTP 200. The authentication result independently gates the member lane before the Data interaction.
harness_quality.transient_state: The running observation is explicitly optional after a bounded probe and retained as unverified; the top-level partial status is correct and does not silently turn into pass.
harness_quality.false_pass_review: No false pass found for the four reported DOM outcomes: each requires the named card under the active Data panel and the corresponding UI text/rows/action. These assertions are not equivalent to screenshots, and their successful evaluation is only recorded in the sanitized native report.
harness_quality.organization_header_finding: FIX REQUIRED: the captured authenticated POST to https://db.matrxserver.com/rest/v1/wbx_pattern returned 201 and its request body organization matched the selected organization, but the native observer recorded headerOrganizationPresent=false. The exact frozen product source corroborates this: DataView calls savePattern with the organization in the body; savePattern uses the ordinary Supabase client; that client sets X-Client-Info only and does not add X-Organization-Id. This conflicts with the repository contract that every authenticated backend request carries X-Organization-Id. The row was correctly read back under the selected organization and then deleted, so this finding does not negate the observed extraction UI states, but it blocks unqualified T08 credit until corrected and re-observed.
harness_quality.visual_evidence_gap: The artifact uploaded generic startup QA screenshots rather than Data-state screenshots; the test result has no screenshots tied to its success/no-match/error states. This limits visual review, while not invalidating the reported live DOM assertions.
harness_quality.secret_handling: No credential values were found in the downloaded report or screenshots; the run manifest also records temporary-secret cleanup.

findings.evidence: Native observation headerOrganizationPresent=false; requestOrganizationMatchesSelected=true; HTTP 201. Exact source at product SHA uses getSupabase() global headers with X-Client-Info only.
findings.effect_on_verdict: T08 automatic success/no-match/error/manual-action UI observations remain bounded evidence, but do not promote the complete member scenario to pass until the org-header contract is met and retested.
findings.required_follow_up: Repair the product request path to carry the selected organization header, then rerun the owned fixture lifecycle and confirm the captured POST header matches the selected organization.
